entries: This fine set of white-and-silver armor bears the wind rune upon its chest.
While wearing this armor, you have advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) checks and Dexterity saving throws as your movements are bolstered by gentle currents of wind.
As an action, you can invoke the armor's rune to cast the {@spell wind wall} spell (save DC 15) with it. Once the rune has been invoked, it can't be invoked again until the next dawn.
entries.name: Invoking the Rune
